sections.name: Learner actions
sections.intro: Think about the last 30 days — work, sport, hobbies, parenting, anything you're trying to get better at. How often did you…

items.text: Choose the harder option when an easier one would have gotten the job done?
Do something you're not good at yet in front of other people?
Ask someone directly for feedback on how you could improve?
Try a new way of doing something you already do well?
After something went badly, take time to figure out what you'd do differently?
Explain something you're still learning to someone else?
Use a coach, course, book, or expert specifically to get better at something?
Pass on a chance to do something because you weren't sure you'd be good at it?
